details:
Q1
Which part of this repository should change?
Choices:
A. Clarify / plan pipeline
B. Implement / review / validate / orchestrate pipeline
C. Documentation / README / operator guidance
D. Other — name the exact workflow, script, or file path to change (RECOMMENDED)
Q2
What specific problem should the change address?
Choices:
A. A workflow or script is failing or behaving incorrectly
B. The current behavior works, but it is too slow, noisy, or expensive
C. The docs or defaults are confusing or incomplete
D. Other — describe the current behavior and the desired behavior in 1–3 sentences (RECOMMENDED)
Q3
What should count as “done” for this issue?
Choices:
A. A named workflow/script/file is updated to fix the problem
B. A specific run result, log output, label flow, or comment behavior changes
C. Other — provide concrete acceptance criteria or a before/after example (RECOMMENDED)
